title: Headers
slide_intent: Show how a header can identify both its institutional source and its specific project. A changing research image gives each topic an entry point.
strategic_value: CSAIL can distinguish seminars and initiatives while the common logo and title placement link them to the lab.
demonstration: Three landscape headers stack a customized image above a white identifier strip. The examples cover CSAIL Rising, an artificial intelligence program and an annual meeting.
practical_value: Choose the image and title for the event, then check how the project-specific content sits beside the lab or group identifier.
